Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Navi's title text cycle - on the mutual funds page, the headline auto-cycles "Zero commission" -> "Zero exit load": the word "Zero" stays fixed while the second word slides vertically out and its replacement slides in, masked to the headline's line box.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Navi's cream-colored page: bold serif headline "Zero commission" with the subline "only on Navi Mutual Funds", above the Set-up account card, the invest-within countdown, and the Highest return funds list. Only the headline's second word animates; the rest of the page is static.

## Motion spec
Pattern: masked vertical word swap on a loop.
- Every ~2.5s, the second word animates: the outgoing word ("commission") slides up and out of the line's clip mask (translateY 0 -> -110%, 350ms, ease-in) while the incoming word ("exit load") slides in from below (translateY +110% -> 0, 350ms, ease-out) in the same window.
- The swap has a slight blur on the moving words (0 -> 2px -> 0) - a smooth, printed feel rather than a hard cut.
- The word "Zero" and the subline never move - the fixed anchor makes the cycle readable.
- The cycle loops continuously through the value props and back to the first.

## Calibration
- Incoming and outgoing words overlap in the mask for ~100ms - simultaneous, not sequential.
- Timing holds 2.5s per phrase - long enough to read "Zero exit load" at a glance.

## Reduced motion
Words swap with a simple crossfade.

## Don't miss
- The mask clips exactly at the headline's line box - the sliding words never bleed over the subline.
- The serif face and tight tracking stay identical across all phrases - only the words change.
